notes.title: First Day Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug so that the flutterers guided achievement will track.
[*]Adjusted pacing
[*]Hitting a critter in mid-air will no longer knock you off of gliding.
[*]Removed an erroneous camera movement. 
[/list]

Thank you to those who have provided feedback to improve our game.
